demoNoteTitle: A little island on your desktop
demoNoteBody:
Keep what matters close. Let the rest settle.

One small island. A workspace you can always come back to.
demoQuestion: How can I stay focused at work?
demoAnswer:
Start with one thing worth finishing.

1. Choose today's most important task.
2. Take 25 minutes and put notifications aside.
3. Write down stray thoughts. Come back to them later.
4. Step away from the screen when you're done. Take five minutes to rest.

Keep a rhythm, rather than pushing all the time.
